title_en: The Glass of Water Before Surgery
note_en: The causative pattern 让 + someone + action means "make / let / have someone do something": 医生的话让她放松了一点 "the doctor's words helped her relax a little" (literally "made her relax"). Likewise: 护士让她去医保窗口办报销 "the nurse had her go to the insurance window to claim reimbursement"; 不让她提重东西 "wouldn't let her carry anything heavy." English uses "make," "let," "have," or "help" depending on the situation.
